_comment: Copy to routes.json (gitignored), or generate it with `node cli.mjs discord-scaffold --write`. Any value written as env:VAR_NAME is read from the environment, so no token or webhook URL is ever committed.

discord._mode: 'webhook' needs nothing but URLs and works in two minutes, but has no buttons. 'bot' needs a bot token and a public interactions URL, and lets coaches action a case with one click.
discord._routeBy: 'group' posts to a channel per team (LEAP's layout). 'coach' posts to a channel per coach. Either way the @mention is always the creator's own coach.
discord._interactionsReady: Set false while the bot can post but its interactions endpoint is not live yet. Cards arrive without buttons instead of with dead ones.
discord._channels: Turn on Developer Mode in Discord, then right-click a channel and Copy Channel ID. Anything that is not 17-20 digits is treated as unset.
discord._inactive: Optional. One channel for every creator earning nothing, so the team channels stay about creators who are live and slipping. Left unset, they go to the team channels.
discord._groups: Team names exactly as the export spells them. Matching ignores case and spacing, so 'TEAM GOLF' here matches a channel you call 'Team Golf'.
discord._coaches: Mentions only when routing by team - the channel comes from the group. A userId here sends a direct message instead.

_plainTextFallback: Used by `cli.mjs report` and the older text digests. Discord above is the live path.
